Hi Sophie — welcome and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a short demo and make it focused on search/recommendation throughput and cost tradeoffs. Before we lock a time, a few quick qualification items so we can tailor the session and bring the right folks: 

1) Primary use case: search relevance tuning, embeddings for recommendations, or reranking? (or a mix)
2) Typical payload size: tokens per prompt (you mentioned ~250) — is that consistent or do you have a distribution?
3) Concurrency profile: steady traffic vs spiky (cart conversion windows) and expected concurrent LLM requests at peak.
4) SLA/latency target for 95th percentile (e.g., <150ms, <500ms)
5) Data sensitivity: any PII or regulated data in prompts?
6) Timeline & success criteria: pilot, production in X months? any cost constraints?

If you can share a quick telemetry export (CSV) with timestamps, endpoint, tokens_in, tokens_out, and 95p latency that would be perfect. I listed three 45-min slots (PST) we can offer next week — pick one if any work, or share a preferred range and Ben will book: 
• Tue Jul 6, 09:00–09:45 PT
• Tue Jul 6, 11:00–11:45 PT
• Wed Jul 7, 08:30–09:15 PT

Ben (cc) will post a calendar invite and include a short intake doc we use for pilots. Monica will join for technical throughput questions.

Cheers,
Vivek
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Thanks, Vivek — fyi answers inline below. Sharing a small telemetry extract as well.

> 1) Primary use case
We want embeddings + reranking for product search first, then personalized recommendations.

> 2) Typical payload size
250 tokens is the median; 95th is around 620 tokens when we include context.

> 3) Concurrency profile
Steady baseline ~3–4 rps, spikes during promotions up to ~45 concurrent LLM calls for short bursts (~10–15 min).

> 4) SLA/latency target
Target <600ms 95p for search; recommendation less strict but ideally <1s.

> 5) Data sensitivity
No regulated PII; product titles and SKU-level info only.

> 6) Timeline
Pilot in Q3 (Aug), production readiness by Q4. Cost sensitivity moderate — we want to compare cost per query vs our current infra.

I've attached quickcart-telemetry-summary.csv (tokens, timestamp, endpoint, latency). Morning PST works best. Any of the Tue Jul 6 times look good; prefer 09:00 PT if available.

Sophie
